en.title: Light Novel Library · Keep your stories close.
en.description: A free, independent Wenku8 and local-book reader for Android, iOS and HarmonyOS.
en.name: Light Novel Library
en.intro: Discover a book, make room for it on your shelf, then settle into reading. An independent reader for Wenku8 and the books you bring with you.
en.coffee: Buy me a coffee on AFDIAN
en.support_note: Voluntary support. All features remain free.
en.section_title: From discovery to the last page.
en.discover_body: Browse books, authors and categories. Keep your favorites close on a three-dimensional bookshelf.
en.read_body: Horizontal, vertical or scrolling. Shape the type, spacing and page to suit you, or listen with text-to-speech.
en.personalize_body: A quiet glass interface, thoughtful color choices and a local library that fits your own collection.
en.discover_alt: Discovery screen with a three-dimensional bookshelf
en.demo: Screens use demo book data. The app interface is in Chinese.
en.note: This is a third-party reading client. It does not operate Wenku8, publish novels or bundle book files. Online content and availability are determined by Wenku8; local books are imported by you.
en.feedback_note: Feedback is accepted for the latest app version only. Wenku8 network and website availability issues are not handled here.
en.activity_scope: Daily deduplication in Beijing time. Only supported reporting versions are included. Refreshed about hourly.
en.activity_error: Daily activity is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
en.activity_empty: The first day's data will appear here once reporting begins.
en.activity_single: Our first day of data. The trend will take shape day by day.
en.activity_stale: This snapshot has not refreshed recently; the last available values are shown.
en.activity_capped: The daily reporting limit was reached; the actual activity may be higher.

zh.title: 轻小说文库 · 把故事，留在手边。
zh.description: 适用于 Android、iOS 与 HarmonyOS 的免费第三方 Wenku8 与本地书籍阅读客户端。
zh.name: 轻小说文库
zh.intro: 发现一本书，为它留一格书架，再安心读下去。为轻小说文库与自己的本地藏书，留一个轻盈、安静的阅读空间。
zh.coffee: 在爱发电请我喝杯咖啡
zh.support_note: 赞助完全自愿，所有功能仍免费使用。
zh.chapter: 为每一个故事留一席之地
zh.discover_body: 浏览书目、作者与分类，把喜欢的作品留在立体书架上，随时回到故事里。
zh.read_body: 横排、竖排或滚动，自由调整字形、间距与页面，也可以换一种方式听故事。
zh.personalize_body: 安静的玻璃界面、合拍的配色，与容纳个人藏书的本地书库，一起适应你的习惯。
zh.read_alt: 可自定义排版的阅读器
zh.demo: 界面书目为演示数据。应用界面为中文。
zh.note: 本项目是第三方阅读客户端，不运营 Wenku8 站点，不自行发布小说资源，安装包不附带小说文件。在线内容及可读状态以 Wenku8 为准；本地书籍由你自行导入。
zh.feedback_note: 仅接受最新版本的应用问题反馈。Wenku8 网络与站点可用性问题不受理，也不回复。
zh.activity_scope: 按北京时间每日去重，仅统计已接入的版本。约每小时更新。
zh.activity_error: 每日活跃度暂时无法加载，请稍后重试。
zh.activity_empty: 开始记录后，首日数据会显示在这里。
zh.activity_single: 这是首日数据，趋势将随每日记录逐步形成。
zh.activity_stale: 快照暂未刷新，当前展示上次成功更新的数据。
zh.activity_capped: 当日已达到统计上限，实际活跃度可能更高。
